mathematical_definition: causal_tercile(hurst_120 - 0.5, 500) -- rolling (trailing, shift(1)) tercile bucket of the recentered Hurst-exponent signal, using rolling(500, min_periods=125).quantile(0.333/0.667).shift(1) thresholds computed strictly from data before the current row. Deliberately reimplements the recentering inline (hurst_120 - 0.5) rather than depending on family G's persistence_score feature, avoiding a same-value cross-family dependency for one subtraction
numerical_stability_notes: causal_tercile's rolling quantile thresholds are ill-defined (NaN) until min_periods=window//4=125 is satisfied; also inherits any NaN from hurst_120's own degenerate-window guard
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first ~125 bars (window//4 min_periods gate on the rolling quantile), and wherever hurst_120 itself is NaN; never zero-filled
